sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocab_writings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "vocab_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "writing" TEXT NOT NULL, "writing_search_form" TEXT NULL, "info" TEXT NULL, "primary_pair" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("primary_pair" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_writings_writing_search_form ON vocab_writings (writing_search_form) WHERE writing_search_form IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocab_readings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "vocab_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reading" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading_search_form" TEXT NULL, "reading_romaji" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading_romaji_simplified" TEXT NULL, "associated_writings" TEXT NULL, "info" TEXT NULL, "pitch_accents" TEXT NULL, "primary_pair" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("primary_pair" IN (0, 1)));
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_readings_reading_search_form ON vocab_readings (reading_search_form) WHERE reading_search_form IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_readings_reading_romaji_simplified ON vocab_readings (reading_romaji_simplified) WHERE reading_romaji_simplified IS NOT NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocabs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "pos" TEXT NULL, "common" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("common" IN (0, 1)), "frequency_score" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocab_definitions" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "vocab_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "definition" TEXT NOT NULL, "additional_info" TEXT NULL, "pos" TEXT NULL, "applies_to" TEXT NULL, "fields" TEXT NULL, "misc_info" TEXT NULL, "dialects" TEXT NULL, "examples" TEXT NULL, "language_source" TEXT NULL, "waseieigo" INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK ("waseieigo" IN (0, 1)), "cross_references" TEXT NULL, "antonyms" TEXT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocab_definition_words" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "word" TEXT NOT NULL, "vocab_id" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_writings_vocab_id ON vocab_writings (vocab_id)
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_writings_writing ON vocab_writings (writing)
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_readings_vocab_id ON vocab_readings (vocab_id)
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_readings_reading ON vocab_readings (reading)
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_readings_reading_romaji ON vocab_readings (reading_romaji)
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_definitions_vocab_id ON vocab_definitions (vocab_id)
CREATE INDEX IX_vocab_definition_words_word ON vocab_definition_words (word)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kanjis" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kanji" TEXT NOT NULL, "radical" TEXT NOT NULL, "components" TEXT NULL, "grade" INTEGER NULL, "stroke_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "frequency" INTEGER NULL, "jlpt" INTEGER NULL, "meaning" TEXT NULL, "strokes" TEXT NULL, "compounds" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kanji_readings" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kanji_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reading" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading_search_form" TEXT NULL, "reading_romaji" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading_romaji_simplified" TEXT NULL, "type" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kanji_meaning_words" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "word" TEXT NOT NULL, "kanji_id" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IX_kanjis_radical ON kanjis (radical)
CREATE INDEX IX_kanji_readings_kanji_id ON kanji_readings (kanji_id)
CREATE INDEX IX_kanji_readings_reading ON kanji_readings (reading)
CREATE INDEX IX_kanji_readings_reading_romaji ON kanji_readings (reading_romaji)
CREATE INDEX IX_kanji_meaning_words_word ON kanji_meaning_words (word)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "spaced_repetition_datas" ("item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "front_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, "interval" INTEGER NOT NULL, "repetitions" INTEGER NOT NULL, "ease_factor" REAL NOT NULL, "due_date" INTEGER NULL, "total_answers" INTEGER NOT NULL, "total_wrong_answers" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("item_id", "item_type", "front_type")) WITHOUT ROWID;
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "vocab_notes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "text_analysis_history_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "analysis_text" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "search_history_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "search_text" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "radicals" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "radical" TEXT NOT NULL, "kangxi_id" INTEGER NULL, "stroke_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "meaning" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading" TEXT NOT NULL, "position" INTEGER NULL, "importance" INTEGER NULL, "strokes" TEXT NULL, "variants" TEXT NULL, "variant_of" TEXT NULL);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UK_radicals_radical ON radicals (radical)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proper_nouns" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "writing" TEXT NULL, "writing_search_form" TEXT NULL, "reading" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading_search_form" TEXT NULL, "reading_romaji" TEXT NOT NULL, "reading_romaji_simplified" TEXT NULL, "romaji" TEXT NOT NULL, "types" TEXT NOT NULL);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "proper_noun_romaji_words" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "word" TEXT NOT NULL, "proper_noun_id" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IX_proper_nouns_reading ON proper_nouns (reading)
CREATE INDEX IX_proper_nouns_reading_romaji ON proper_nouns (reading_romaji)
CREATE INDEX IX_proper_noun_romaji_words_word ON proper_noun_romaji_words (word)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "predefined_dictionary_lists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "vocab" TEXT NOT NULL, "kanji" TEXT NOT NULL, "grammar" TEXT NOT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "my_dictionary_lists" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(LENGTH("name") > 0), "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "my_dictionary_list_items" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "list_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "item_type" INTEGER NOT NULL, UNIQUE ("list_id", "item_id", "item_type"));
CREATE INDEX IX_my_dictionary_list_items_list_id ON my_dictionary_list_items (list_id)
CREATE INDEX IX_my_dictionary_list_items_item_id_type ON my_dictionary_list_items (item_id, item_type)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kanji_component_connections" ("kanji_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "component_code_point" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("component_code_point", "kanji_id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "kanji_notes" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "grammars" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "form" TEXT NOT NULL, "meaning" TEXT NOT NULL, "construction" TEXT NULL, "jlpt_level" INTEGER NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NULL, "practice" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flashcard_sets" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "using_spaced_repetition" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("using_spaced_repetition" IN (0, 1)), "front_type" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (0), "vocab_show_reading" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("vocab_show_reading" IN (0, 1)), "vocab_show_reading_if_rare_kanji" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("vocab_show_reading_if_rare_kanji" IN (0, 1)), "vocab_show_alternatives" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("vocab_show_alternatives" IN (0, 1)), "vocab_show_pitch_accent" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("vocab_show_pitch_accent" IN (0, 1)), "kanji_show_reading" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("kanji_show_reading" IN (0, 1)), "vocab_show_parts_of_speech" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("vocab_show_parts_of_speech" IN (0, 1)), "show_note" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("show_note" IN (0, 1)), "timestamp" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT (CAST(strftime('%s', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AS INTEGER)), "predefined_dictionary_lists" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "my_dictionary_lists" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "streak" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "flashcard_set_reports" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "flashcard_set_id" INTEGER NOT NULL, "date" INTEGER NOT NULL, "due_flashcards_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "due_flashcards_got_wrong" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "new_flashcards_completed" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0);
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UX_flashcard_set_reports_flashcard_set_id_and_date ON flashcard_set_reports (flashcard_set_id, date)
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dictionary_infos" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "version" INTEGER NOT NULL);
CREATE INDEX IX_proper_nouns_writing ON proper_nouns (writing) WHERE writing IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IX_proper_nouns_writing_search_form ON proper_nouns (writing_search_form) WHERE writing_search_form IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IX_proper_nouns_reading_search_form ON proper_nouns (reading_search_form) WHERE reading_search_form IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IX_proper_nouns_reading_romaji_simplified ON proper_nouns (reading_romaji_simplified) WHERE reading_romaji_simplified IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IX_proper_nouns_romaji ON proper_nouns (romaji COLLATE NOCASE) WHERE romaji
CREATE INDEX IX_kanji_readings_reading_search_form ON kanji_readings (reading_search_form) WHERE reading_search_form IS NOT NULL
CREATE INDEX IX_kanji_readings_reading_romaji_simplified ON kanji_readings (reading_romaji_simplified) WHERE reading_romaji_simplified IS NOT NULL
